items.english: I am sorry to hear that. Do you have joint pain?
items.adapter: Ó dùn mí láti gbọ́ èyí. Ṣé o ní ń bá ọ̀sì?

items.reference: O ṣeun, mo ti kọ èyí sínú àkọsílẹ̀ rẹ. jọ̀wọ́ sọ fún mi bí nǹkan bá yí padà.
items.english: Thank you. I have written that in your record. Please tell me if anything changes.
items.adapter: O ṣeun, mo ti kọ èyí sínú àkọsílẹ̀ rẹ. jọ̀wọ́ sọ fún mi bí nǹkan bá yí padà.

items.reference: O ṣeun pé o sọ fún mi.
items.english: Thank you for telling me. How many days have you had it?
items.adapter: O ṣeun pé o sọ fún mi.

items.reference: Mo ti kọ èyí sínú àkọsílẹ̀ rẹ fún àwùjọ tó ń bójú tó ẹ, tó bá wá burú sí i, lọ sí ilé ìwòsàn tó sún mọ́ ẹ jù lọ tàbí ilé ìwòsàn.
items.english: I have written this in your record for your care team. If it gets worse, go to the nearest clinic or hospital.
items.adapter: Mo ti kọ èyí sínú àkọsílẹ̀ rẹ. jọ̀wọ́ sọ fún mi bí nǹkan bá yí padà.

items.reference: Ó dùn mí gan-an láti gbọ́ bẹ́ẹ̀.
items.english: I am sorry to hear that. Do you have worry that you cannot control?
items.adapter: Ó dùn mí láti gbọ́ èyí. Ṣé o ní ń bá ọ̀sì?
